The fish has a pale cyan transparent head dome with two prominent tubular eyes, curved line cues around the eye structures, sparse graphite-gray hatching and shading, scattered bubbles and tiny water marks, all enclosed by a thin irregular rounded black outer contour on warm bone-white paper. The rendering closely maintains the established monochrome-plus-cyan hand-drawn material, contour, paper, and lighting language.
